title: High-Level Design

node_notes.alert: This is the real MQTT alert sink for vehicle/cabin/alert. The network service publishes it when threshold_service_trigger reports a configured climate or g-force violation.
node_notes.rtos: This component emits boot/reset and periodic RTOS metrics such as heap, CPU, task, and uptime data. main/entry.c starts it through firmgen_telemetry_start and the component emits JSON on UART0.
node_notes.mqtt: This is the configured MQTT TCP endpoint at broker.hivemq.com port 1883. network_start_mqtt loads the endpoint and starts an esp_mqtt_client instance.
node_notes.threshold: This box evaluates configured temperature, humidity, and maximum-axis g-force limits. firmware/modules/threshold_evaluator.c implements threshold_service_trigger, while threshold_service_load obtains persisted settings.
node_notes.entry: This is the application entry shim that starts both Firmgen components and then calls app_start. main/entry.c provides the app_main implementation and its three startup calls.
node_notes.dhtsvc: This service continuously decodes DHT22 frames, validates checksums, stores climate values, and exposes dht22_service_sample. The implementation is firmware/services/dht22_service.c and uses the platform port contract.
node_notes.mpusvc: This service initializes and samples the MPU6050, then stores lateral, longitudinal, and vertical acceleration state. firmware/services/mpu6050_service.c connects the portable driver callbacks to the ESP32 I2C port.
node_notes.i2c: This is the ESP-IDF I2C master bus used by the MPU6050. i2c_new_master_bus and i2c_master_bus_add_device establish the bus and device at 100000 Hz.
node_notes.nvs: This is the nonvolatile configuration store for the vehicle MQTT endpoint and threshold records. The network and threshold services use nvs_open, nvs_get, nvs_set, and nvs_commit.
node_notes.app: This is the application startup owner for the sensor, network, and diagnostics tasks. firmware/app/app.c uses osal_task_create for DHT22, MPU6050, and network work and starts diagnostics separately.
node_notes.mpu6050: This box is the MPU6050 motion sensor at I2C address 0x68. Its register identity check, reset, configuration, and accelerometer reads are implemented by firmware/services/mpu6050_service.c and the MPU6050 driver.
node_notes.network: This is the network aggregation and publication service. firmware/platforms/esp32/network_service_esp32.c reads both sensor states, initializes NVS, starts WiFi and MQTT, queues failures, and evaluates alert thresholds.
node_notes.diagnostics: Diagnostics task is a step in this firmware's runtime flow. The cite firmware/platforms/esp32/diagnostics_service_esp32.c is the source evidence for it.
node_notes.dht22: This box is the DHT22 climate sensor wired to data GPIO 2. The ESP32 port performs open-drain signaling and reads the frame through gpio_get_level and gpio_set_level in firmware/platforms/esp32/dht22_port_esp32.c.
node_notes.uart: This is the console/UART logging sink for application and diagnostic messages. ESP_LOGI, ESP_LOGW, and ESP_LOGE are used throughout the sensor, network, and diagnostics implementations.
node_notes.wifi: This is the ESP-IDF WiFi station configured with APP_WIFI_SSID and its event handlers. network_start_wifi calls esp_wifi_init, esp_wifi_set_mode, and esp_wifi_start.
node_notes.scl: This is the MPU6050 I2C clock binding on GPIO 8. firmware/platforms/esp32/mpu6050_port_esp32.c assigns APP_MPU6050_SCL_GPIO to the i2c_master_bus_config_t SCL field.
node_notes.sda: This is the MPU6050 I2C data binding on GPIO 9. The same ESP-IDF bus configuration assigns APP_MPU6050_SDA_GPIO to the SDA field.
node_notes.proto: This component monitors wrapped I2C, UART, WiFi, and MQTT calls and emits protocol JSON. main/entry.c starts it through firmgen_proto_monitor_start, and the component documentation specifies UART0 output.
node_notes.telemetry: This is the real MQTT telemetry sink for vehicle/cabin/telemetry. The network service publishes JSON containing temperature, humidity, and three acceleration axes.
